scope: Strengthen caller-state assertions in the existing ASCII/Binary DATATABLE allocation rollback and retry sweep.

source.profile: One AC1024 DATATABLE with four typed columns and two rows, two XRECORD row children, and generated handle remapping. No external sample or fixture file is used.

implementation.method: After each injected DATATABLE writer allocation failure and same-codec retry, compare the full public DATATABLE payload used by the fixture, including table identity/owner/base state, counts, name, references, every column type/name, and every long/double/string cell value. Preserve the existing prior-destination bytes, child identity, same-writer retry, byte comparison, and fresh typed readback checks.

limitations: Generated AC1024 transaction and typed-readback evidence only; producer behavior, independent interoperability, and native DATATABLE semantics remain open.
The generated XRECORD child checks retain identity/owner assertions; this change's expanded field-by-field comparison applies to the DATATABLE caller object.
P6-G remains open pending the writer inventory diff and coverage of remaining public writers.
nextAction: Continue the P6-G writer inventory and caller-state audit with a remaining public writer lacking equivalent payload comparisons.
